Yummus

Ingredients:

1 - 15oz Can of Garbanzo Beans

1/4 cup Water

1/4 cup Lemon Juice

1/4 cup Lime Juice

1/2 cup Sesame Tahini (Joyva)

1 teaspoon Sugar

1 teaspoon Salt

3/4 teaspoon White Pepper

1/4 teaspoon Cumin

1/8 teaspoon Cayenne Pepper

1/2 tablespoon Olive Oil

Add a few sprigs of Cilantro

Garnish: fresh chopped Roma Tomatoes, fresh Basil, and Garlic. (optional)

Directions:

Rinse and strain garbanzo beans

Place garbanzo beans into a bowl and fill with water so the water surface is just above the beans

Microwave garbanzo beans 1-2 minutes until warm.

Rinse and strain garbanzo beans again in cold water. 

Add other ingredients and blend until the desired consistency is reached. 

Add garnish (optional).

Enjoy <3
